name: vendor-ledger
description: For optimization of vendor invoice tracking and payment ## Project Purpose:   - This application is to optimize vendor invoice tracking and payment for small business ## Essential Features:  - 1.	Keep a list of vendors. Who you do business with.  - 2.	Enter an invoice. Vendor information, what it’s for, amount, invoice date, and terms. The app works out the due date based on invoice date and term (net 30 terms).  - 3.	Mark it completed and approved. Was the order completed and did someone approve payment  - 4.	See what to pay. A screen that lists the invoices ready to pay (completed, approved, not yet paid), showing who, how much, and when, with the soonest due date first.  - 5.	Record the payment. Paid in full, with the date. ## Team and Responsibilities:  - I am completing this solo, so I will be handling all design, implementation, and testing.
